acceptance.item: Native WheelEvent prototype getters and accumulation before paint
acceptance.evidence: Ctrl/Meta 24-event one-task bursts use browser WheelEvent; ctrlKey/metaKey/deltaMode are inherited. Frame sequence unchanged within the burst; final input camera fully accumulates.

acceptance.item: Accumulation across requestAnimationFrame and direction reversal
acceptance.evidence: Ctrl/Meta 24-event sequences interleave RAF every 3 events from nontrivial initial camera; zoom, both anchor coordinates and reversal match independent arithmetic.

acceptance.item: CSS origin/zoom, anchor, pixel/line/page pan and modifier units
acceptance.evidence: Nonzero CSS origin and 1.25 CSS zoom use actual WheelEvent received client coordinates; zoom anchor holds. Line/page units are native WheelEvent fields, with strict x/y pan arithmetic. Production Ctrl-line (-0.5 line) plus Meta-page (-0.01 page) also matches exact cumulative modifier zoom and both anchor coordinates.

Real mouse wheel scrolls Markdown and production CEF HTML without changing camera. Modifier wheel zooms canvas without changing content scroll; production CEF color popup ordinary wheel keeps camera and modifier wheel zooms.

acceptance.item: WebKit relative scale, duplicate channel suppression and native end
acceptance.evidence: Synthetic capability path start scale2 to change3 yields1.5, repeated native scale and concurrent wheel produce no extra scaling; native end restores wheel. Invalid scale has no camera effect.

acceptance.item: Two contacts, remaining contact and single-contact restoration
acceptance.evidence: Chrome CDP native touch dispatch maps to PointerEvent. Two contacts in Mark preserve objects/annotations, remaining contact creates no annotation, subsequent single Mark works. Drag-to-pinch yields1.5 with unchanged object version; ordinary single drag then persists exact expected position.

acceptance.item: Cancellation, page lifecycle and source scope
acceptance.evidence: Native touchCancel restores wheel. Direct PointerEvent lostpointercapture tests handler recovery. Synthetic pagehide/pageshow/blur reset input ownership; actual authenticated fixture-only source view closure creates a distinct fresh view and wheel accumulates from retained camera. Actual mouse drag cancellation releases capture with zero layout writes; Mark cancellation produces zero annotations.

Dedicated production test switches session through full navigation and verifies late native change does not affect either session; source inspection confirms controller reset and session ownership checks.

limitations: DOM WheelEvent uses actual browser prototype accessors but events are synthetic, not physical trackpad input.
CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent exercises Chrome native touch-to-PointerEvent dispatch; physical touchscreen not measured.
WebKit capability is synthetic in Chrome; Safari hardware not measured.
Persisted PageTransitionEvent tests lifecycle handlers; actual bfcache navigation not measured.
CDP releasePointerCapture did not emit actual lostpointercapture in reviewer measured sequences. Direct dispatch verifies the handler only; physical capture loss is unmeasured.
Physical trackpad, physical touchscreen, Safari and actual bfcache navigation are unmeasured.
Existing dedicated session test uses full navigation; in-place session change was source-reviewed.

harnessCorrections.reason: WheelEvent constructor rounds client coordinates; oracle now uses actual received browser event coordinates with unchanged strict camera tolerance. Initial requested-coordinate assertion remains in original raw artifact.
CDP release did not deliver lostpointercapture. Native-delivery assertion remains failed in raw artifacts; final handler case directly dispatches PointerEvent and explicitly limits scope.
Final predicate matches only records created after the current close; historic distinct view records cannot satisfy it.
Final mouse input uses image area outside the later HTML overlap and actual observed mouse pointer id.
